refId.description: Opaque ref://session/tool/uuid; a locator, never authority.

ttlMs.description: 0 means session lifetime; otherwise at most 604800000 milliseconds.

offset.description: 1-based line or 16-byte hex row; default 1. Legacy 0 also reads the first unit.

inspect_local_file.description: Read bounded UTF-8 text lines or a hex view from path relative to the DSH session cwd. Directories are rejected; use ops_glob or ops_grep. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

refId.description: Opaque ref://session/tool/uuid; a locator, never authority.

ttlMs.description: 0 means session lifetime; otherwise at most 604800000 milliseconds.

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from a complete scan. Keep query options unchanged; omit offset or use nextOffset. SEARCH_STALE requires a fresh query.

grep.description: Search UTF-8 files below path relative to the current session cwd. pattern is ONE Rust regex string; filter files with glob, an ARRAY of relative globs ("!" excludes). There is no include field. Use summary for aggregate file/match totals, count for per-file counts, files_with_matches for paths, content for text (default); limit defaults to 100 items. Optional line context. Paging uses 0-based offset/nextOffset; prefer continuation with unchanged options. Each page rescans; SEARCH_STALE means restart. Check scanComplete and pageComplete; matchedTotal exists only after a complete scan, matchedObserved is a lower bound otherwise. skipReasons explains gaps. Narrow incomplete scans instead of blindly paging. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

refId.description: Opaque ref://session/tool/uuid; a locator, never authority.

ttlMs.description: 0 means session lifetime; otherwise at most 604800000 milliseconds.

matchedTotal.description: Present only after a complete scan.

pattern.description: At least one positive glob is required.

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from a complete scan. Keep query options unchanged; omit offset or use nextOffset. SEARCH_STALE requires a fresh query.

glob.description: Find regular files below path relative to the current session cwd. pattern is an ARRAY of globs matched against paths relative to path: ["**/*.md","!vendor/**"]; "*.md" matches the top level only, "!" excludes, at least one positive entry. Symlinks, reparse points, hidden files and dependency/build directories are excluded. limit defaults to 100; paging uses 0-based offset/nextOffset. Check scanComplete and pageComplete; matchedTotal exists only after a complete scan. Prefer continuation with unchanged options; SEARCH_STALE means restart. Incomplete scans require a narrower query. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

ttlMs.description: 0 means session lifetime; otherwise at most 604800000 milliseconds.

matchedTotal.description: Present only after a complete scan.

replace.description: Replace LITERAL text (pattern is not a regex) in UTF-8 files under path; glob filters files as in ops_grep. dryRun observes only; writes use revision checks and atomic replacement. Read-only sessions are rejected. Darwin nonempty extended ACLs fail closed with METADATA_UNSUPPORTED. Windows preserves owner/group/ordered DACL and supported basic attributes/timestamps; readonly overwrite is refused and unsupported streams/EA/special storage fail with METADATA_UNSUPPORTED. SACL/audit labels are not preserved. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

ttlMs.description: 0 means session lifetime; otherwise at most 604800000 milliseconds.

expectedRevision.description: 64 lowercase hex SHA-256 revision returned by inspect/stat; absent is create-only, never an overwrite wildcard.

write_file.description: Create or fully overwrite one UTF-8 file; parents must exist. Required expectedRevision is the observed SHA-256, or absent for create-only. Atomic CAS, short receipt with new revision/bytes/lineCount; dryRun only previews. Darwin nonempty extended ACLs fail closed with METADATA_UNSUPPORTED. Read-only denies even dryRun. Windows preserves owner/group/ordered DACL and supported basic attributes/timestamps; readonly overwrite is refused and unsupported streams/EA/special storage fail with METADATA_UNSUPPORTED. SACL/audit labels are not preserved. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

ttlMs.description: 0 means session lifetime; otherwise at most 604800000 milliseconds.

expectedRevision.description: 64 lowercase hex SHA-256 revision returned by inspect/stat; absent is not accepted.

edits.description: 1-100 nonoverlapping edits against the same original bytes.

oldText.description: Nonempty text that occurs exactly once in the original.

edit_file.description: Precisely patch one UTF-8 file using 1-100 oldText/newText edits against the SAME original bytes. Every nonempty oldText must occur exactly once; overlapping edits reject all. Required expectedRevision from inspect/stat. Atomic CAS; dryRun previews. Darwin nonempty extended ACLs fail closed with METADATA_UNSUPPORTED. Preserve CRLF/BOM explicitly in text. Windows preserves owner/group/ordered DACL and supported basic attributes/timestamps; readonly overwrite is refused and unsupported streams/EA/special storage fail with METADATA_UNSUPPORTED. SACL/audit labels are not preserved. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

diff.description: Read-only comparison of one UTF-8 file with content. Returns one prefix/suffix-trimmed replacement hunk (not a minimal diff), paged 0-based offset/limit (default 100). Includes old/new hashes and line counts; no publication. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

stat.description: Inspect one regular file: SHA-256 revision, bytes, UTF-8 lineCount (null for binary), timestamps and permissions; no content. Missing paths return exists:false, revision:absent. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

ttlMs.description: 0 means session lifetime; otherwise at most 604800000 milliseconds.

expectedRevision.description: 64 lowercase hex SHA-256 revision returned by inspect/stat; absent is not accepted.

copy.description: Copy ONE regular file to absent to (relative to session cwd); parents must exist. Required expectedRevision checks source. Atomic no-clobber destination; preserves metadata or fails closed. Windows preserves owner/group/ordered DACL and supported basic attributes/timestamps; readonly overwrite is refused and unsupported streams/EA/special storage fail with METADATA_UNSUPPORTED. SACL/audit labels are not preserved. Darwin requires APFS cloning and currently refuses nonempty extended ACLs with METADATA_UNSUPPORTED before staging; use a dedicated metadata-aware tool for ACL-bearing files. No directories/links; recursive work uses ops_batch when available. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

expectedRevision.description: 64 lowercase hex SHA-256 revision returned by inspect/stat; absent is not accepted.

move.description: Move ONE regular file to absent to, same filesystem only. Required source expectedRevision. Atomic no-clobber destination then source unlink; failures after publication carry effectState:applied. No copy-delete fallback, directories or links. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

path.description: Regular file path relative to the current session cwd.

format.description: Default tsv for .tsv paths, otherwise csv.

encoding.description: Strict decoding; conflicting BOMs fail. No replacement characters.

header.description: First record is columns when true; empty/duplicate column names stay positional.

read_table.description: Read bounded CSV/TSV lexical string cells relative to session cwd. Preserves quoted multiline records and physical LF lineStart/lineEnd. Check scanComplete versus pageComplete; total/revision exist only after a stable full scan. Up to 32 MiB, 100000 data records, 1 MiB/record, 1024 columns and 30s; row paging cannot bypass scan gaps. Errors retain safe preceding rows with nextAction. Compare revisions before combining rescanned pages. No spreadsheet formulas or type coercion. Failures return status:error|rejected and error.code; never throw.

refId.description: Opaque ref://session/tool/uuid; a locator, never authority.

ttlMs.description: 0 means session lifetime; otherwise at most 604800000 milliseconds.

path.description: Regular DOCX file path relative to the current session cwd. Binary DOC is unsupported.

read_docx.description: Read bounded DOCX main-body paragraphs relative to session cwd, preserving Unicode text and table/row/cell coordinates. Scope excludes layout, headers/footers, notes, comments and metadata; complete applies only to that scope. Standard stored/deflated ZIP, strict UTF-8/BOM UTF-16; unsupported content and parse errors retain safe preceding paragraphs with nextAction. Check scanComplete versus pageComplete; total/revision require a stable full scan. 32 MiB archive, 8 MiB main XML, 1 MiB/paragraph, 100000 paragraphs, 30s. Paging cannot bypass physical gaps; compare revisions across calls. No binary DOC, macros, external fetch or extraction to disk. Failures return status:error|rejected and error.code; never throw.

path.description: Regular PDF file path relative to the current session cwd.

read_pdf.description: Read bounded PDF 1.3-1.7 page text and individual runs relative to session cwd. Restricted classic-xref PDFs with standard Helvetica/Courier/Times Type1 fonts and Standard/WinAnsi encoding only. Scope is text-layer content order; excludes rendered reading order, images/OCR, annotations/forms and metadata. Unsupported or malformed later pages retain preceding complete pages with error/nextAction. Check scanComplete versus pageComplete; total/revision require a stable full scan. 16 MiB input and aggregate decoded/processed streams, 1 MiB/page, 32 pages, 30s. Page offsets cannot bypass physical gaps; compare revisions across calls. Failures return status:error|rejected and error.code; never throw.
